value.title: How do ICS students get these results?

items.title: Teachers who mark the HSC
items.text: Several of our teachers are official HSC markers for NESA, so they know what examiners want to see.

items.title: Small senior classes
items.text: Senior classes are small enough for teachers to give each student real attention. Every Extension 1 and Extension 2 course is available.

items.title: A mentor for every Year 12 student
items.text: Each Year 12 student meets with a staff mentor once a week. Mentors help students balance study with the rest of life and keep them on track with their goals.

items.title:
Study skills from
Year 7
items.text: Students learn how to study well through a seminar program that builds each year, along with study days in the senior years.

stories.title: Jeremy Smark Dux
stories.lead: Jeremy joined ICS in Year 6 and quickly embraced the opportunities to learn and grow within the school community. He has valued experiences that challenged him, from collaborative projects to creative pursuits, and has appreciated the friendships and support that have shaped his journey.
stories.summary: Academically, Jeremy’s inquisitive nature and determined effort have driven him to excel in a rigorous program that includes advanced mathematics, sciences, and languages.
stories.story:
Academically, Jeremy’s inquisitive nature and determined effort have driven him to excel in a rigorous program that includes advanced mathematics, sciences, and languages. His achievements reflect both intellectual curiosity and perseverance. Highlights include representing Australia in international problem-solving competitions, earning distinctions in national academic challenges, and participating in elite programs that extend learning well beyond the classroom. These experiences showcase his love of learning and his ability to thrive when faced with complex ideas and demanding expectations.

Beyond academics, Jeremy has embraced opportunities to serve and lead. His faith has been a guiding influence, shaping how he approaches study and life with humility and purpose. He has contributed to the school community through leadership roles, mentoring younger students, and fostering a culture of encouragement and integrity. Jeremy also pursued creative and technical interests, from performing in orchestras to engaging in engineering and robotics projects, demonstrating a commitment to growth across diverse fields.

Jeremy’s time at ICS reflects a balance of academic excellence, character development, and service. His achievements are a testament to his curiosity, resilience, and desire to use his gifts for the benefit of others.

value.title:
Help with
every pathway
value.text: Not every student wants an ATAR, and that's fine. Our careers advisers work with students and families from Year 9 to Year 12.
value.subtitle: Their program includes:

bullets.title: a week of work experience in Year 10
help choosing subjects in Years 10 and 11
VET courses, school-based apprenticeships and distance education
careers days at school and visits to university and TAFE open days in Wollongong and Sydney
help with early entry, scholarship, apprenticeship and cadetship applications

value.note: Families can also use our careers website at icscareers.info
